name: Test Generation Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to generate and run Go tests using sin_test_generate and sin_test (issue #75 / RFC-test-automation).

test_cases.prompt: There is a Go file calc.go with package calc and a function Add(a, b int) int. Use sin_test_generate to generate tests for it, then run sin_test to verify the tests pass.
test_cases.description: Smoke test for sin_test_generate + sin_test workflow.

test_cases.prompt: A file reverse.go contains package reverse with func Reverse(s string) string. The test file reverse_test.go does not exist yet. Generate tests with sin_test_generate and run them.
test_cases.description: Tests generation of a previously untested file.

test_cases.prompt: Run the quality gate with sin_quality_gate on the current workspace and ensure it returns PASS.
test_cases.description: Verifies the sin_quality_gate tool can run successfully.
